cases.d: Join the online meeting room with camera and microphone.
steps: After the Chair starts an online meeting, click "Vào phòng họp".
Check the preview ("Xem trước hình của bạn"), toggle "Tắt micro" / "Bật camera" and click "Vào phòng".
Open Người dự, Tin nhắn and Tài liệu in the room.
exp: The room opens full screen; other participants appear with their names and "Đang nói" indicators.
Chat messages appear for people in the room only.
Leaving returns to the meeting page.
pre: A Published online meeting; LiveKit configured; browser camera and microphone allowed.

cases.d: The room is closed before the start and for in-person meetings; only the Chair mutes others.
steps: Open the room of a meeting that has not started.
Open the room of an in-person meeting in progress.
In a running room, as a member try to mute someone; as the Chair, mute a member ("Tắt mic").
exp: Not started: "Phòng họp chỉ mở khi cuộc họp đang diễn ra".
In person: the room says the meeting is held in person.
Only the Chair has "Tắt mic"; the member's microphone turns off.

cases.d: Share the screen and use the floating window.
steps: In the room, click "Chia sẻ màn hình" and choose a window.
Click "Mở cửa sổ nổi", switch to another tab, then "Đóng cửa sổ nổi".
exp: Others see the shared screen and "Bạn đang trình bày cho mọi người" is shown to you.
In the floating window "Bạn vẫn đang trong phòng và có thể làm việc khác ở tab hoặc ứng dụng khác." and the call continues.
pre: A running online meeting room with two participants.

cases.d: Open a meeting document from inside the room.
steps: In the room, open Tài liệu and click a document.
exp: The document opens in a new tab ("Mở ở tab mới, bạn vẫn ở trong phòng").
The call in the first tab keeps running.
pre: A running online meeting with documents.
